tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search the archive of technology stories and AI lab releases by keyword or topic. Returns matching stories with their original URL, date, source, the companies they are about, and a siteUrl on distribute.software.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about recent technology news, e.g. 'What did Apple announce this week?'. Returns a short answer written from the site's stories, with the stories it cites. Slower than search_stories; use search_stories for plain lookups.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Today's top technology stories (UTC), mixed across Hacker News, newsrooms and Reddit the way the site ranks them, the AI labs' releases of the last two days, and the companies with the most coverage this week. Early in the UTC day it returns yesterday.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One story by id ('story-123' or 123, as other tools return it): its original URL, source, score, companies, discussion thread, and the comments readers left on distribute.software.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: Model and product releases posted by the AI labs themselves (newsrooms, changelogs and model lists), newest first.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company's last 30 days: how many stories mentioned it, its best covered recent stories, and, for AI labs, its own posts. Links to its page on distribute.software.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Every company stories are tagged with: slug, name, the product names that count as the company, and its story count for the last 7 days.

tools.name: list_labs
tools.description: The AI labs whose own posts the site follows: id, name, posts in the last 30 days, and their page.

tools.name: trending_questions
tools.description: Searches many readers of distribute.software made this week, most asked first: a quick read on what people want to know about the news.

tools.name: submit_tip
tools.description: Send the editors a story the site is missing. Needs an API key in the Authorization header (Bearer <key>); request one at https://distribute.software/submit. Tips go to a review queue and are never published automatically.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_stories" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, since, company, limit, context, llm_model, conversation_id

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "trending_questions" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_tip" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Send the editors a story the site is missing. Needs an API key in the Authorization header (Bearer <key>); request one at https://distribute.software/submit. Ti…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stories, get_story, get_company, list_labs · Private data: submit_tip · Public sink: submit_tip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stories, get_story, get_company, list_labs · Private data: submit_tip · Public sink: submit_tip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
